title: Knoema Engine: An Open Runtime for Persistent NPCs, Synthetic Replay Research, and Reproducible Agent Simulation
description: Knoema Engine is an MIT-licensed Python runtime for persistent social agents with explicit persona, memory, relationship, emotion, environment, deterministic replay, and optional LLM-backed decision surfaces. Public-safety examples are fictional, synthetic, and non-identifying; the project is not designed for prediction, suspect scoring, surveillance, or enforcement automation.
notes: Release metadata prepared during Phase 31. A DOI is assigned only after the repository or release archive is connected to Zenodo under the Celovin account.
